before:
`flask.sansio.app.App.select_jinja_autoescape` decides autoescaping from the
template's extension and compares it exactly, so a file named `INDEX.HTML` is
not autoescaped.
after:
`flask.sansio.app.App.select_jinja_autoescape` decides autoescaping from the
template's extension and compares it case-insensitively (via `.lower()`), so
a file named `INDEX.HTML` is autoescaped.
